evals.prompt: Write a PerfectScale executive 1-pager I can share with the customer VP who has buying authority. Rank their clusters high to low by Potential Max Savings and cover PodFit vs InfraFit plus ROI. Top 9.
evals.expected_output: Trigger skill. N=9 from prompt (do not re-ask). First reply asks only Gate A: confirm API key available OR pscli authorized/logged in. Do not start Overview/API until confirmed and pscli auth status succeeds. Then customer MD+PDF, POV wording, no science experiment.

evals.prompt: Same 1-pager approach for Acme, top 3 clusters only, and ignore any workload whose name contains BillingWorker at the customer's request.
evals.expected_output: Trigger skill. N=3 and exclusion BillingWorker from prompt. First reply Gate A only (auth). After auth, 1-page brief with BillingWorker footnote on every cluster.

evals.prompt: Need a POV one-pager for the technical exec who can approve PerfectScale — not a science experiment, make it a buying decision.
evals.expected_output: Trigger skill. N missing → ask Gate B (how many clusters). Also Gate A (API key or pscli). Do not assume 9. Copy uses POV not science experiment. No analysis until both gates pass.

evals.prompt: pscli is already logged in. Run the executive 1-pager for Northwind Logistics, top 9 by Potential Max Savings, exclude Kestrel.
evals.expected_output: Trigger skill. N=9, customer=Northwind Logistics, exclude=Kestrel. Still verify pscli auth status before starting (do not skip verification). Then run analysis.
